app.name: CleanYourTV
app.promise: Disable TV bloatware over Wi-Fi, and restore it anytime.
start.title: A fresh start for your TV
choose.title: Choose a list for your TV
choose.note: Each list is specific to the model named. Read the package names and comments before continuing.
confirm.title: Confirm your list
confirm.body: Packages will be disabled, not uninstalled. Restore your TV anytime. The script skips packages protected by its safeguards.
progress.title: Progress
progress.wait: Keep this page open until the script finishes.
done.title: Done
done.review: Review the script output below for results and any warnings.
launcher.title: Install the CleanYourTV launcher?
launcher.intro: A simple home screen with an Apple TV look.
launcher.body: A pitch-black background, a dock of four favourite apps, an app grid when you press the Down button, a clock and date, plus Inputs, Wi-Fi and Settings buttons. The launcher is bundled; Android Studio is not needed.
launcher.homeKey: Enable HomeKeyService: fixes the Home key sending ALL_APPS on Xiaomi TV Stick, and opens Settings from the remote's gear button.
launcher.unknown: The script stopped because another launcher it does not recognise, such as Projectivy, owns Home. You can retry without disabling that launcher.
launcher.keepHome: I agree to retry with -StockLauncher none; the existing launcher stays enabled.
restore.title: Restore TV
restore.pick: The last list for this TV is selected when available. Otherwise, choose the list you used before.
restore.explain: The script uses the recovery record for this TV and list. Without a record, it warns and enables every package in the list.
restore.launcher: The launcher stays installed. Remove it in the TV's
exit.title: CleanYourTV is closed
error.PORT_CLOSED: Port 5555 on the TV is closed. Check Network debugging or USB debugging. Some boxes (Mi Box) need a restart after network ADB was closed.
error.PROBE: Could not connect to the TV. Check Wi-Fi and debugging, allow the connection on the TV, then retry.
error.SCRIPT: Could not run the script or read its output. Review the output and retry. Reinstall CleanYourTV if files are missing.
error.INPUT: Check the IP address and list. Connect to the TV first and wait for any other job to finish.
language.label: Language
flow.label: Your progress
setup.title: Prepare your TV
setup.intro: Keep your TV remote nearby. Choose your TV brand and follow these steps.
setup.debugNote: Some TVs only show USB debugging. Keep it turned on while connecting over Wi-Fi.
connect.title: Connect to your TV
connect.intro: Make sure your TV is switched on and connected to the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
connect.tips: Check that your TV is on, both devices are on the same Wi-Fi, and debugging is turned on. You can also enter the TV’s IP address manually.
connect.manualHint: Find it in your TV’s network settings.
connect.authorizeTitle: Allow this computer on your TV
connect.authorizeBody: Look at the TV screen. Use your remote to select “Always allow from this computer”, then “Allow”.
connect.mockLabel: Example of the permission dialog on your TV
connect.waiting: Waiting for permission on the TV…
connect.authorizeHint: Choose the highlighted options on your TV, not on this computer.
connect.authorizeTimeout: Permission was not received within two minutes. Check the TV screen, then try again.
error.RESTORE_FIRST: Run Restore TV first before disabling packages with a different list or app selection.
confirm.keep: Tick what you want to keep: streaming apps, voice assistant, Chromecast, Miracast and firmware updates. Only unticked packages will be disabled.
adb.title: Close ADB
adb.last: This is the last step. Install the optional launcher first if you want it, because it needs adb.
adb.debugging: Turn off USB debugging and Network/ADB debugging on the TV. Turn off Wireless debugging too if available.
adb.revoke: Revoke all USB debugging authorisations on the TV.
adb.restart: Restart the TV. Wait until it is back on and confirm its IP address is unchanged before checking the port.
adb.closed: Port 5555 is closed or not responding. Make sure the TV is back on and its IP address is unchanged.
adb.open: Port 5555 is still open. Turn off all debugging options, revoke authorisations, restart the TV and check again.
adb.failed: Could not check the port. Make sure the TV is on and on the same network, then try again.
